# feega

> feega is an AI infinite canvas. Text, image, video, audio and document nodes are generated, connected and edited on one board by a person, by the built-in chat, or by an external agent over MCP. Finished material is scheduled to social accounts and run as Meta ads.

- App: https://oh.feega.app
- MCP server: https://mcp.feega.app/mcp
- Support: support@feega.app — General: hi@feega.app

## What it does

- Image generation: GPT Image, Nano Banana, Seedream, Qwen.
- Video generation, text-to-video and image-to-video with first/last frame, up to 15 s per clip: Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0, Grok Imagine.
- Video upscaling up to 30 s per clip: FLUX Video Upscale.
- Audio: text to speech, voice changer, dubbing, music, sound effects, voice isolation.
- Image effects: glitch, RGB shift, dither, halftone, pixelate, posterize and more.
- Products imported from a connected store; social calendar and publishing; Meta ad campaigns approved before they run.

## What it does not do

- Background removal, automatic captions, video colourization, 3D model export (GLB/FBX), ads outside Meta.
